    Botanical Extracts

    Ginger

    Zingiber officinale

    CO2 and solvent extracts standardized on gingerols, shogaols, and zingiberene.

    Part used

    Overview

    Ginger rhizome extract is valued for two compound families — gingerols (pungent, dominant in fresh root) and shogaols (form as the root dries, more pungent still), plus zingiberene, which carries the warm, woody aroma. Extraction method genuinely changes the product here: CO2 extraction favors the aromatic fraction, solvent extraction pulls a broader-spectrum oleoresin, and steam distillation yields the pure essential oil.

    Frequently asked

    Not covered here? Ask our team.

    Which ginger form should I use?

    CO2 oil for a clean aromatic profile with no residual solvent; solvent extract for the broadest-spectrum oleoresin at lower cost; essential oil for aroma only, no pungency compounds.

    Do you provide a Certificate of Analysis?

    Yes, COAs are available per batch — this will be provided alongside your order.
